2026_02_PHI_TEN.headline: Fangio’s Eagles defense tests Tennessee’s developing offense
2026_02_PHI_TEN.paragraph1: Philadelphia travels to Tennessee with a schematic matchup that both clubs highlighted when the schedule was released. The Eagles framed Vic Fangio’s defense against second-year quarterback Cam Ward as a central test, while the Titans enter a new era under head coach Robert Saleh. Tennessee’s best route is to stay out of obvious passing downs and keep the full playbook available. Philadelphia wants the opposite, because long-yardage situations let the Eagles disguise coverage and make Ward solve the picture after the snap.
2026_02_PHI_TEN.model_rationale: Philadelphia’s coverage structure against Tennessee’s developing passing game determines whether the Eagles can force Cam Ward into obvious situations and shrink the Titans’ margin for error.
